newsitem.title: FINLAND: FIM BONDS CLOSE FIRMER TRACKING BUNDS,ACTIVE TRADE.
newsitem.headline: FIM BONDS CLOSE FIRMER TRACKING BUNDS,ACTIVE TRADE.

text.p: Finnish bonds closed firmer in active trade on Tuesday, buoyed by firmer Bunds and a positive international sentiment, dealers said.
"The market is a little overbought. I think it will weaken slightly on Wednesday, we will not go through 6.00 (percent on the 2006 bond yield) in the long end," one dealer said.
Eyes were on U.S. May consumer confidence figures due at 1400 GMT, they said.
The markka eased on remarks by a Finnish finance ministry official that it was likely to be irrevocably fixed to the euro near its 3.04 per mark ERM central parity, forex dealers said.
